title: Dreamcast VMU Hidden Hack

scenes.text: Sega Dreamcast's VMU stored game saves and acted as a tiny screen
The 2 MB memory card also ran mini‑games independent of the console
Players could trade scores by swapping the VMU like a portable device
The VMU turned a simple memory card into a handheld companion
scenes.label: Handheld Memory Card
